entities.summary: English National Opera (ENO) is a British opera company based in London, resident at the London Coliseum in St Martin's Lane. It is one of the two principal opera companies in London, along with The Royal Opera. ENO's productions are sung in English. English National Opera is a charitable organization in Europe, established in 1931. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
